title: Hamster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='25' r='8' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='25' r='8' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='25' r='5' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='25' r='5' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e86a8a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 52 Q50 57 54 52' stroke='#c94f6d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q18 48 22 38' stroke='#f4a3b8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- right arm down -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q80 58 82 66' stroke='#f4a3b8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
  <!-- feet / dancing legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='88' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f4a3b8'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffe66d'>
    <path d='M80 18 L80 30 L86 28 L86 16 Z'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='30' r='4'/>
    <path d='M14 20 L14 30 L18 29 L18 19 Z'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='30' r='3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='4' fill='#ffd6e0'/>
</svg>
